name: tests-75pct-throttled-py-bounded-resilient-store-operations
instr:
Add operation control to synchronous and asynchronous memory and Redis stores. Preserve existing behavior.

Use an absolute monotonic deadline for memory lock waits, synchronous Redis lazy connection, and asynchronous memory retry delays. Expired memory mutations leave scalar/hash values unchanged. Failed lock waits preserve later LRU behavior; deadline expiry during an asynchronous retry delay leaves the lock usable.

Pre-cancellation starts no attempts. Cancellation after a failed Redis mutation prevents replay in both execution styles, including with mutation retries enabled. Redis reads retry connection failures and retain integer conversion. Mutations do not retry by default. Exhaustion raises StoreOperationFailure with the final report and last backend exception as both last_exception and __cause__.

Count started attempts and successful completions separately: success completes one attempt; transport failures, deadline expiry, and pre-cancellation complete none. Completed reports remain stable, compare equally across packages, and completed operations cannot be reused. Controlled memory validation retains DataError without retrying: zero-timeout set and missing hash values leave data unchanged; scalar reads of hashes start one attempt.

These are required in what you deliver:

- Export StoreOperationReason, CancellationSignal, StoreOperationReport, StoreOperation, StoreOperationFailure from throttled.store and throttled.asyncio.store; both export the same StoreOperatio
